def: Two network tiers: scale-up links a small group of accelerators so tightly they act almost as one device (NVLink, TPU ICI); scale-out joins many such groups over InfiniBand or Ethernet.
practice: Keep tensor and expert parallelism inside the scale-up domain, which NVL72 racks grew to 72 GPUs; data and pipeline parallelism tolerate the slower scale-out network.
